title: ELSPR: Evaluator LLM Training Data Self-Purification on Non-Transitive Preferences via Tournament Graph Reconstruction

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the presentation order of candidate response pairs in the evaluation prompt to check if the evaluator LLM's preference changes based on the order of appearance.

Modeling evaluator LLM pairwise comparisons as directed tournament graphs and utilizing Strongly Connected Components (SCCs) and two-dimensional structural entropy to detect and quantify cyclical, contradictory preference relationships.
